title: Heavy Late Fees Measured against the Missed Minimum (Crestline Credit Card)
content:
Northgate's late-fee courtesy credit on the Crestline Credit Card eases a fee that is heavy against the payment it penalizes: when the minimum payment due on the statement whose minimum was missed is less than 2 times the late fee, 0.15 is added to the share of the late fee that the courtesy credit returns; when it is at least 2 times but less than 4 times the late fee, 0.05 is added; otherwise nothing is added. The share, with every addition made to it, never exceeds 1.0 — the whole fee.

## Figures compared

- **The late fee:** the most recent late fee entry on the card ledger.
- **The missed minimum:** the minimum payment due printed on the statement that late fee was charged for.

## Addition table

| Missed minimum compared with the late fee | Added to the share |
|---|---|
| less than 2 times the fee | 0.15 |
| 2 times the fee or more, but less than 4 times | 0.05 |
| 4 times the fee or more | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical fee of 20.00 USD)

| Missed minimum | Ratio to the fee | Added |
|---|---|---|
| 39.99 USD | just under 2 times | 0.15 |
| 40.00 USD | exactly 2 times | 0.05 |
| 79.99 USD | just under 4 times | 0.05 |
| 80.00 USD | exactly 4 times | nothing |
